QuestInfo.name: The Four Paradoxes
QuestInfo.0: What are these paradoxes mentioned in the second scroll? Ask Grendel the Really Old.
QuestInfo.1: What are these paradoxes mentioned in the second scroll? Ask Grendel the Really Old.
QuestInfo.2: Grendel the Really Old found something. See what he has to say.

0.0: Did the scroll have what you needed?\r\n#L0##bSo it would seem.#l\n#k
0.1: Great! Then you'll be off to Harmony now, I suppose.\r\n#L0##bNot quite. I seem to be missing some necessary items.#l\n#k
0.2: True. It's always a good idea to pack a toothbrush.\r\n#L0##bToothbrush? No, I... There's a certain ritual I must perform, but I don't quite understand the items I need for it. I'm certain a toothbrush isn't one of the items, though.#l\n#k
0.3: Boy, aren't you a serious one? But you've piqued my interest. Tell me more about these mysterious items.\r\n#L0##bThe items are all paradoxes. I need cold flames, hot chills, destructive creation, and eyes that see darkness.#l\n#k
0.4: Oh, a puzzle! I love puzzles! Give me a moment...

yes.0: Yes, I read something about this in a book somewhere.

no.0: I just need a moment. Are you in that much of a hurry?
